description: Tests a sink by sending it a sample alert. Give a saved sink ID to test its stored configuration, optionally with a webhook draft to test unsaved edits. A draft replaces the stored body and headers; an empty webhook URL keeps the stored URL, and an empty header value keeps the stored value of the header with the same name, as long as the URL is kept. With a new URL, every header value must be given again, so a stored secret is never sent to another address. Without an ID, supply a complete webhook with its URL. Checks never save configuration changes.

renderedBody.description: The JSON body that was sent, rendered from the template with sample alert data. It never holds a secret.
renderedBody.title: renderedBody

sinkID.description: The saved sink used as the default destination and credential source for the check.
sinkID.title: sinkID

status.description: Succeeded when the destination answered with a 2xx status. Failed when it could not be reached or refused the request.
status.title: status

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the response, when the destination answered.
statusCode.title: statusCode

type.description: The type of the sink to test.
type.title: type

webhook.description: The webhook draft to test instead of the stored configuration. With sinkID, an empty URL keeps the stored one, and so does an empty header value unless the URL is changed. Without sinkID, the URL is required. The draft is never saved.
webhook.title: webhook
